recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch of 'JULY ADS 2026' Creative
recommendations.detail: The account currently has 0 active campaigns. Immediately relaunch a new Lead Generation campaign using the creative from 'JULY ADS 2026'. That creative achieved a 4.33% CTR, indicating very strong engagement with the vehicle imagery or offer, which should be the foundation of your restart.

recommendations.title: Broaden Targeting to Lower $355 CPM
recommendations.detail: Historical data shows an extremely high CPM of $355.78. When relaunching, remove narrow interest overlays and use a broader 50-mile radius around the dealership with an 'Open' audience (Age 25-65+). This is necessary to bring the CPM down to a healthy range ($15-$30) and reduce the $87.28 cost per message.

recommendations.title: Transition Objective to Leads (Messenger)
recommendations.detail: The previous top campaign used the 'Sales' objective. For dealership Messenger leads, test the 'Leads' objective with 'Messenger' as the conversion location. This often optimizes better for conversation starters at a lower cost than the Sales objective for local service/retail.
